acceptance: A planner runs the open brainstorm session multi-operator-0-3-2 (technical lens) through both rounds with its seed notes, records the ideas with specy-road brainstorm add-idea, and recommends a ranked set with specy-road brainstorm recommend
The maintainer accepts or rejects the recommended ideas; accepted ones are promoted to roadmap nodes for 0.3.2 with specy-road brainstorm promote, and the session is closed
Nothing is built in this leaf: its output is the brainstorm record and the promoted nodes
nodes.title: Run the multi-operator brainstorm for 0.3.2 (two or more operators on several machines, plus a PM in the PM GUI)
